title: Special Topics in Information Studies; Generative AI in UX: Transforming UX Practice
description: Generative AI is rapidly redefining HCI practice. We ll cover the uses, limitations, and potential of LLMs like ChatGPT and image generators, developing strong prompting skills, such as AI-driven ideation, persona analysis, simulation, and narrative methods. You ll learn to engage deeply and critically with the end-to-end UX process through AI tools and to design generative AI experiences.
